title: Logix branding & UI configuration
description: Shared configuration consumed by the Windows sign-in popup, the central server, and the admin dashboard. All keys are optional; anything omitted falls back to built-in defaults. Copy windows/logbook_config.example.json or server/server_config.json and edit — never hardcode branding in source. This schema mirrors server/main.py's DEFAULT_CONFIG exactly; tests/test_config_schema.py fails if the two drift apart.

_comment.description: Free-text note; ignored by all consumers.

branding.description: Visual identity shared across popup, dashboard, and reports.

logoText.description: Short text logo shown when no image is set.

logoPath.description: Absolute path to a logo image (optional).

colors.description: Client & dashboard palette. The client (Windows popup/timer) resolves these via Get-LogbookTheme with the deep-navy Client Foundation defaults; a lab re-themes by overriding any key.

signals.description: Solid status-bar signal colours -- status is a colored edge on a calm surface, never a tinted card.

text.description: All user-facing labels and hint strings. Localize here without touching code.

requiredFields.description: Which form fields must be filled before a session can start.

devices.description: Device-naming options surfaced in the admin dashboard's Settings tab.

device_types.description: Category options offered when naming/labeling a device.

naming_pattern.description: Suggested template for device display names, e.g. "{type} - {room} - {number}".

category.description: This device's category, delivered by the server. Selects which idle_auto_end policy applies.

idle_auto_end.description: Per-category idle auto-end policy (Settings > Perangkat). Ships disabled for every category so an upgrade never starts closing sessions on its own. Idle is measured from input AND compute load, so long-running jobs stay 'active'. The user is warned 5 minutes before the session closes.

enabled.description: When false the category never auto-ends; the client reads the threshold as 0 = never.

hours.description: Idle hours before the session is closed automatically.

reports.description: Defaults for the Excel report generator (logix/logbook_report.py) and GET /api/reports.

default_scope.description: Which range the report modal pre-selects.

privacy.description: Descriptive text shown to users about what's collected -- NOT the same as LOGIX_PRIVACY_MODE (an agent-local env var controlling whether logix/log_physical.py syncs to the central server at all; see docs/PRIVACY.md). This object never gates behavior, only what's displayed.
